demos.name: Privilege Google Secrets Lab
demos.description: Privilege Hubs brokering a Google Secret Manager credential to an AI agent: the agent holds only a Privilege agent access key, the Hubs gateway's policy allows the in-scope secret (custodian release) and refuses the out-of-scope ask — the refusal is the product. Mock gateway, mock custodian, mock Google Secret Manager; mock-issued secret labelled.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7827). Mock needs no tenant and no credentials. Docker: HOST_PORT=7827 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). No live mode: the lab contacts no gateway and no Google API in any mode; PGS_MODE_REAL=1 only enables the rule-19 Real switch. Real mode against the owner's existing gateway is owner-configured via .env, not shipped.
